messages:
auditor_jane: Hi team — auditor request: please provide consolidated evidence for SOC2/ISO control mapping. Need: 1) RBAC change history for org-admin and infra-admin roles (last 12 months) with approvals; 2) KMS key rotation records for prod keys (links/snapshots); 3) vuln triage notes for CVE-2024-XXXX tied to incident IN-2024-55; 4) timeline and post-incident review doc. Preferred format: CSV for logs + PDF for approvals. Deadline EOD Wed. Thanks.

maria.chen: Ack, I can pull RBAC change logs and approval tickets. Do you want raw audit logs or a summarized CSV with who/when/why?

auditor_jane: Summarized CSV is ideal, but include raw logs as well for sampling. PDFs for approval tickets ok. Also need chain-of-custody for evidence exports.

aj: For RBAC logs you can run the admin-audit query in CloudLog -> export. Quick query I use:
```
resource.labels.project_id="redwood-prod"
protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy"
protoPayload.request.policy.bindings.role: ("roles/orgAdmin" OR "roles/infraAdmin")
timestamp >= "2023-03-01T00:00:00Z"
```
Then export to BigQuery and CSV.

maria.chen: Perfect, I'll export and attach the BigQuery snapshot + CSV. Will also tag the approval JIRA numbers.

nate: For KMS rotation proof, run this AWS CLI to show rotation timestamps for CMKs we manage:
```
aws kms list-keys --profile prod
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id> --profile prod
aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id> --profile prod
```
We have rotation audit events in CloudTrail; I can pull a filtered export for the prod key aliases.

sre-bot: export started: evidence-export-1987654321.tar.gz (size 6.8MB) — contains: rbac.csv, rbac_raw.ndjson, kms_rotations.csv, cve-triage.md, in-2024-55-til.json

maria.chen: Quick Q — for the vuln triage, do you want the full JIRA ticket thread or a redacted summary?
auditor_jane: Full tickets (public attachments redacted ok) + summary bullet points.

aj: Also note PS: our RBAC changes include some temporary role grants for migrations in 2023-11; include justification notes from SR-320.

maria.chen: Adding SR-320 notes and approval PDFs. ETA EOD tomorrow.

auditor_jane: Thanks. One more: can you include the incident response timeline with UTC timestamps and the list of responders? PDF or markdown ok.

nate: I'll paste the timeline into a markdown and upload. Quick sample snippet:
```
2024-02-21T14:03:12Z - Alert triggered (anomalous auth)
2024-02-21T14:05:40Z - PagerDuty incident created
2024-02-21T14:08:10Z - SRE oncall (aj) acknowledged
2024-02-21T14:35:22Z - Key rotation performed for alias/redwood-prod-key (via KMS)
2024-02-21T15:10:00Z - Containment confirmed
```

maria.chen: Uploading attachments to the evidence bucket and will share presigned links. Naming: evidence_engsec_1987654321/*.zip

sre-bot: presigned links generated: https://storage.redwood.internal/evidence_engsec_1987654321/rbac.csv (exp 7d)

auditor_jane: This is great, thank you. Once you drop the links I'll validate samples. :white_check_mark:

maria.chen: Links dropped and folder manifest attached. Ping me if anything is missing. :eyes:
